messages:
bryce: Quick sync — proposing a new 'Scale' pricing tier + two add-ons: Priority Routing and Burst Credits. Need to align scope, launch criteria, constraints. Thoughts? :thinking:
ash (sales): We have 3 pilot prospects asking specifically for guaranteed burst windows and priority routing. They asked for ~10k burst tokens/day. Sales needs a clean SKU to sell.
maria (eng): Define 'burst' behavior: is it pre-warmed capacity, a cold-queue that waits, or token-bucket credit that can spike? each has different infra cost.
jyoti (finance): If bursts are unbounded we lose predictability. We need chargeable credits or a high-priced unlimited SKU. Metrics we care about: ARR uplift, expected overage, and margin impact.
liz (eng-runtime): Technically feasible as a token-bucket counter + short-term prewarm pool. Implementation hit: need prefix caching adjustments and a short-lived GPU pool for headroom. Risk: cache-priming cost.
kim (legal): Contracts need explicit overage, termination, and SLA changes for Priority Routing. Also routing priority may affect compliance guarantees for Private deployments — flagging.
matt-bot: Draft pricing matrix uploaded to Confluence: https://internal.redwood/confluence/pricing-scale-tier (draft).
ash (sales): Can we offer a trial: 1 month of 50k burst credits for enterprise pilots? That helps signers.
bryce: Proposal: implement bounded Burst Credits (monthly bucket), Priority Routing (add-on per-seat or per-commit), and a new 'Scale' tier which includes X base tokens + discounted add-ons. Launch stages: pilot -> closed beta -> GA.
raj (ops): Capacity note: to guarantee bursts we need headroom or fast autoscale. Fast autoscale causes expensive prewarmed nodes. Estimate: +2 GPU pools for initial rollout, ops cost ~+$20k/mo.
maria (eng): Resource ask: +2 eng sprints to add quota/billing APIs + telemetry (burst counters). SLO work: ensure tail latency during bursts stays <2x baseline.
carl (design): Console work: add toggle for Priority Routing, visible burst counter, estimated cost projection in the usage UI. Also need admin controls for disabling bursts per project.
jyoti (finance): Rough pricing sketch — we should test three variants:
```
Scale tier: base 1M tokens/mo $Xk
Burst addon: 10k credits = $Y per month (scales)
Priority routing: $Z/mo per commit (or percent uplift on token price)
```
Numbers TBD, but finance needs elasticity models by EOY.
sarah (cs): Customers will ask about refunds for failed bursts. Recommend clear support playbook + escalation path.
liz (eng-runtime): For performance isolation, enforce per-customer soft limit with controlled fallback to slower model variant if exhausted — avoids noisy-neighbor.
bryce: Launch criteria (draft): 1) Pilot customers onboarded and no>2% failed bursts, 2) Tail latency regression <5% across test prompts, 3) Clear contract language and billing flow in place, 4) Console UX for admins, 5) Capacity runbook + cost forecast signed off.
ash (sales): +1 to pilot-first approach. We need a simple one-line sell: "Scale tier + burst credits to handle temporary traffic spikes with cost predictability".
kim (legal): I'll draft contract clauses for overages + priority routing SLA escalation. Need product to confirm expected limits to avoid open-ended liability.
raj (ops): Also flag monitoring: build burst alerting (consumption rate, exhaustion time) and automated throttles. Ops can own runbook.
bryce: Next steps: bryce to consolidate scope and send meeting invite with engineering, sales lead, finance, legal, ops, and design. Target: finalize scope + pilot SKUs by next Wed. :thumbsup:
file_notes: thread about pricing/packaging roadmap decisions: new Scale tier + add-ons (Priority Routing, Burst Credits). Includes proposal, infra impacts, legal/finance notes, launch criteria, and next steps.
